duplication_audit.novel_axis: hard amplitude-quantized local length-3 word composition over fixed PAA blocks
duplication_audit.distinction: v57 reports rank-tertile LZ76 compressibility but not which local words occur; v29 uses recurrence and ordinal geometry; v26 uses convolution PPV/max. v69 retains a fixed histogram over explicit amplitude-quantized local words without recurrence distances, random kernels, or compression parsing.
duplication_audit.cross_problem_adjacency: P1 v18 used soft five-state PAA adjacent transitions. v69 discloses that adjacency but is P3-new and uses hard Gaussian SAX symbols with length-3 word composition rather than soft adjacent products.
duplication_audit.official_exclusion: official feedback is excluded from features, gates, model fitting and candidate selection

encoder.input: four past-only native channels transformed to the fixed 20-minute grid
encoder.normalization: per-case per-window median and 1.4826 times MAD; zero-scale maps to zero
encoder.word_rule: all ten overlapping length-3 words from the twelve fixed PAA symbols; normalized frequency over all 125 words

model.target: six-lead target_hs minus exact uniform alpha 0.425 reference
model.train_fold_scaler: median and IQR, clip standardized features to [-8,8]

validation.surface: EXPLORATORY_ONLY repeatedly exposed 182 complete historical cases
validation.gate: pooled delta<0, >=4/6 blocks, episode and block-station CI90 upper<0, sealed block/lead/station-lead/reference-tail guards

primary_sources.citation: Lin, Keogh, Wei and Lonardi, Experiencing SAX: a novel symbolic representation of time series, Data Mining and Knowledge Discovery 15, 107-144 (2007)
primary_sources.use: symbolic dimensionality-reduction motivation only; no P3 performance claim
